import sys,time,math
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import analyze as AN, stress_feas as SF, z3
from fractions import Fraction
norm=AN.validate(SF.gen(4,mode='feasible'))
L,coeff=AN._prepare(norm)
snap=norm['snapshots'][0]
nc=len(norm['comm_ids']); ne=len(norm['edge_ids']); edges=norm['edges']
xs=[z3.Int('x%d'%i) for i in range(nc)]
cons=[]
for ci in range(nc):
    lo,hi=snap['bounds'][ci]; cons+=[xs[ci]>=lo,xs[ci]<=hi]
for e in range(ne):
    expr=AN._link_expr(xs,coeff,e,nc)
    if expr is not None: cons.append(expr<=L*edges[e]['capacity'])
for o in snap['observations']:
    expr=AN._obs_expr_L(norm,xs,coeff,L,0,o['metric'],o['target'])
    cons.append(z3.And(expr>=L*o['lo'],expr<=L*o['hi']))
xr=[z3.Real('r%d'%i) for i in range(nc)]
consr=[]
for ci in range(nc):
    lo,hi=snap['bounds'][ci]; consr+=[xr[ci]>=lo,xr[ci]<=hi]
for e in range(ne):
    expr=AN._link_expr(xr,coeff,e,nc)
    if expr is not None: consr.append(expr<=L*edges[e]['capacity'])
for o in snap['observations']:
    expr=AN._obs_expr_L(norm,xr,coeff,L,0,o['metric'],o['target'])
    consr.append(z3.And(expr>=L*o['lo'],expr<=L*o['hi']))
def fof(v):
    if z3.is_int_value(v): return Fraction(v.as_long())
    return Fraction(v.numerator_as_long(), v.denominator_as_long())
def lp_opt(cons,expr,maximize):
    o=z3.Optimize(); o.add(cons)
    h=o.maximize(expr) if maximize else o.minimize(expr)
    o.check(); return fof(o.upper(h) if maximize else o.lower(h))
def ifeas(cons,expr,v,ge):
    s=z3.Solver(); s.add(cons); s.add(expr>=v if ge else expr<=v); return s.check()==z3.sat
t=time.time();checks=0
for ci in range(12):
    M=lp_opt(consr,xr[ci],True); hi=M.numerator//M.denominator
    while not ifeas(cons,xs[ci],hi,True): hi-=1; checks+=1
    checks+=1
    m=lp_opt(consr,xr[ci],False); lo=-((-m.numerator)//m.denominator)
    while not ifeas(cons,xs[ci],lo,False): lo+=1; checks+=1
    checks+=1
print('12 demand LP+SAT',time.time()-t,'checks',checks)
